text:
sara: noticing SCIM churn from Okta org `studio-inc` 

tony: symptoms?

sara: create -> deprovision -> recreate for same externalId. logs show `normalize_extid: found control char` then `kms: unwrap error: invalid padding`

mike: likely upstream NameID contains NUL or non-printable. Did we recently change the mapping?

sara: yes, mapping prepends tenant `tenant + ':' + nameid` (deployed 2026-03-18)

infra-bot: alert SEC-2026-03-03 created. tags: scim,kms,okta

tony: short fixes: 1) pause reconcile for affected users, 2) add defensive normalization that base64-encodes non-printable segments with `b64:` prefix

mike: agree, don't silently drop bytes. add backoff: after 3 decrypt failures mark record `manual_review` and stop automatic re-provision

sara: I'll run an emergency SQL to pause the noisy accounts and open a PR for the normalize+backoff.

sara: SQL to mute: `UPDATE users SET reconcile_paused = true WHERE id IN (2011,2019);`

tony: coordinate with platform-ops for a small Okta mapping rollback window if needed. I'll post to #incidents once PR is live.

mike: tests: unit for printable vs non-printable branch, and a quick staging Okta e2e.

sara: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/eng-identity/pull/504 (adds b64 branch + backoff counter). will request expedited review.

infra-bot: incident status: acknowledged -> in_progress

sara: will update thread as we progress. thanks everyone.
